notes: An emitter belongs here only when the launchpad itself or a reputable integration doc publishes it (status 'confirmed'), or when we found it on-chain and say so (status 'observed'). Several launchpads share one event signature (Pons v1 / NoxaFun, Flap / RealFun), so the emitter allowlist, not the topic, decides attribution. Anything else with a matching topic is reported as unverified. URLs are only filled in where we verified them; a wrong link in a provenance tool is a phishing risk. 2026-10-28 (update-21): added the Uniswap Liquidity Launcher (pools.trade), Bags, letscash.fun, Klik, DYOR.fun and ApeStore, and anoncoin as a Doppler integrator. Bottom.fun is known (factory 0x1bed2687321074a198302c004036b51923812b18, hook 0xd23c94bd8cbeb48c169c020e16a844aeab2368cc) but its contracts announce no launch event, so it cannot be attributed by event; the Doppler integrator 0xae478d7652b1ca5da070aa8563fce1570b420db5 (a Safe 2-of-4, also on Base and Ethereum, users on Coinbase Smart Wallets) is not identified yet and stays unlisted.

launchpads.name: Doppler protocol
launchpads.stack: Permissionless launch protocol (Whetstone Research). Any app can launch through the Airlock; the integrator stored per asset names the app.

emitters.label: Airlock
emitters.source: docs.doppler.lol/reference/contract-addresses (Robinhood Mainnet 4663)

0x92d435c96e63c43e12d6d0ab28f6b0b04072f7.source: Not published by Long. On-chain 2026-09-21: 205 of 205 sampled launches with this integrator carry Long's 1e18 address suffix, 0 of 95 with any other integrator; most call Long's launcher 0x1eef016f.

0xf60633d02690e2a15a54ab919925f3d038df16.source: Not published by Bankr. On-chain 2026-09-23: this integrator launched musebook and Agrippa, both traded on bankr.bot's terminal; Bankr is a documented Doppler integrator; every sampled token from it carries the 'ba3' address suffix (vanity, like Long's 1e18) and a 100B supply. On-chain 2026-10-27: 72 of 78 launches carried Bankr's documented allocation (15%, 30-day cliff, 1 year) or none; the 19 with instantly unlocked allocations (14-50% of supply) are not listed on bankr.bot. No wallet rule on this chain: Bankr's launch wallets are EOAs delegated (EIP-7702) to ZeroDev Kernel v3.3 (0xd6cedde84be40893d153be9d467cd6ad37875b28, accountId kernel.advanced.v0.3.3), a public account implementation that other apps' users have too (anoncoin's smart accounts, 2026-10-27), so it cannot tell a Bankr launch from anyone else's. A claim here can be refuted by its allocation, never confirmed by its sender.

allocations.source: docs.bankr.bot (token-launching/overview, faq/token-launching) and the launch form, checked 2026-10-27: 'Creator vesting: 15% ... vests over 1 year with a 30-day cliff' or 'No vesting' (100% into the pool); 'A Doppler launch has no custom percentage or schedule.' Partner/org launches sell 100% with no vest.

0xd8a823e4e416df7a8bfa412ae06f5d5639a1db.source: Not published by anoncoin. On-chain 2026-10-28: 36 of 36 launches with this integrator in 24 h point tokenURI at cdn.anoncoin.it; the metadata of SPOOKYDOGE (0xa3b3e3c6b5a26b9a81f9b8f2e7934a207e50d09e) gives external_url anoncoin.it/coin/<token> and 'Network: Robinhood Chain', and that page is live. Launch senders are EOAs delegated (EIP-7702) to ZeroDev Kernel v3.3, shared with Bankr's, so there is no wallet rule.
